changelog: Sales: an "Assigned to you" card on top of `/sales` and a strip above the columns on `/sales/board` list the records that came to the rep from someone else (an admin's assignment or transfer, a colleague's hand-off) until the rep opens them. New nullable columns `MentorshipRelation.assignedAt` / `assignedById` / `assignmentSeenAt`, written by `transferMentorship()` and `POST /api/mentorship`, read only through `src/lib/assignedToYou.ts`, cleared when the owner opens the lead page (not under impersonation). Older rows read as seen (#3874).

en: Sales: leads assigned or handed over to you now appear in an "Assigned to you" card at the top of your dashboard and above the board, until you open them.
tr: Satış: sana atanan ya da devredilen lead'ler, sen açana kadar panelin en üstündeki "Sana atananlar" kartında ve panonun üstünde görünüyor.
de: Vertrieb: Leads, die dir zugewiesen oder übergeben wurden, erscheinen jetzt oben im Dashboard in der Karte „Dir zugewiesen“ und über dem Board, bis du sie öffnest.
